body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Ranks anomalous observations against known explanations. (Proposed capability.) An evidence analyzer would take anomalous measurements, enumerate mundane explanations, and rank new-physics hypotheses by Bayesian evidence. The workflow is demonstrated in particle-physics analyses; a general tool is simulated. Status: simulated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
